name: Digital Nomad status of residence (Designated Activities / 特定活動)

requirement_groups.name: Remote worker for a foreign employer or client

requirements.blocker_text: Requires the applicant's own annual income to be at least JPY 10,000,000 (roughly USD 67,000) at the time of application.
requirements.fix_path: Document annual income at or above the JPY 10,000,000 threshold.

value.note: Restricted to nationalities on the Immigration Services Agency's published list of countries that are BOTH visa-exempt for short-term stays in Japan AND have a tax treaty with Japan.

requirements.blocker_text: Restricted to nationals of countries that are both visa-exempt for short-term stays in Japan and have a tax treaty with Japan, per the Immigration Services Agency's published country list.

Requires that all income-generating work be the provision of services or sale of goods to entities based outside Japan via information and communications technology; taking up employment or any secondary job with a Japan-based organisation is prohibited.
Requires private travel/medical insurance covering death, injury and illness, with treatment-cost coverage of at least JPY 10,000,000, valid for the full intended stay.
requirements.fix_path: Purchase qualifying insurance coverage before applying.

evidence_required.document: Proof of foreign employment or client contracts conducted via ICT
Proof of annual income at or above JPY 10,000,000 (tax returns, employer certificate)
Private medical insurance certificate with JPY 10,000,000 treatment-cost coverage for the full stay
Proof of nationality from a qualifying visa-exempt and tax-treaty country

outcome.duration_length: up to 6 months per stay, non-renewable; a new application may be filed no sooner than 6 months after the previous departure from Japan
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: No residence card is issued; the holder must depart Japan by the end of the 6-month period and cannot switch to another status of residence from within Japan.

sources.title: Immigration Services Agency of Japan (moj.go.jp/isa) -- Designated Activities: Digital Nomad status and accompanying spouse/child
Immigration Services Agency of Japan -- Digital Nomad status requirements document (income, insurance, eligible countries)

notes: NEW ROUTE, added in this pass: Japan had 14 other routes built (including highly_skilled_professional, business_manager, startup_visa) but no route for its actual Digital Nomad status, despite the status existing since 2024. Both sources are the Immigration Services Agency's own domain (moj.go.jp/isa), directly fetched. JPY 10,000,000/year is a materially higher income bar than every other digital-nomad-type route in this dataset (Spain ~EUR 34,000, Portugal ~EUR 44,000, Brazil USD 1,500/month, Malaysia USD 24,000-60,000, South Africa ZAR 650,796, Thailand THB 500,000 in savings not income) -- Japan's product is positioned as high-income-only by design, not broadly accessible. This is also the shortest and least generous outcome of any work_independent route in the dataset: 6 months, explicitly non-renewable, no residence card, no path to PR or citizenship, and no switchable_to targets -- structurally similar in dead-end shape to Thailand's DTV and South Korea's F-1-D but with a materially shorter duration than either. Dependents (spouse/child) receive a mirrored 6-month Designated Activities status for 'daily activities,' not employment -- family_can_work is correctly false. HONEST SOURCING GAP: tier-3 sources (e.g. english.visajapan.jp) label this status's implementing instruments as 'Notification 53' (primary applicant) and 'Notification 54' (dependents) and give a March 2024 launch date; neither the specific notification numbers nor the exact launch date were independently confirmed against a tier-1 source in this pass, so they are not asserted in this file's structured fields.
